g.text: Redis loss before vs after A14: stalls and mid-block time vanish, PAN windows and runtime entries remain

g.text: Stacked in-situ ns per request (positive costs up, savings and slack down); the black mark is the measured total (L before, G after). Hatched = sampled shares, solid = timed.

g.text: shares of sampled fragment time, not additive costs: the 12:42 PAN ablation removed 0.00 us of CPU although windows sample at 486 ns (the time reappears in the other fragment classes). No spread

g.text: is shown: these are derived medians; quartiles of G are in the entry. Platform: M1/HVF guest (4 vCPUs) on a shared, noisy host; ratios and spreads, not absolute hardware numbers.
